change_control: Never edit v1 after scored evaluation. Create a new version, record rationale, freeze all assets, and pass its digest explicitly to scored commands. Exploratory probes must be labeled unscored. Model/adapter qualification must be frozen in a new registration before scored end-to-end evaluation if options change.
limitations: Eight seeded synthetic tasks provide feasibility evidence only; no statistical superiority claim.
Candidate receives arguments but never oracle source or expected values.
Only tasks and micro arms explicitly implemented by runners can be scored.

rationale: Freeze edit/retrieval/handoff/cache implementations after deterministic adapter tests. Preserve v2 task prompts, oracles, gates and budgets. Runtime observations justify thinking-off as the initial coding setting; thinking comparison remains measured.
selection_policy: Micro results inform an explicitly versioned end-to-end registration; no silent arm/model/budget changes.
